steps.en: Clone the monorepo and enter the pinned Nix dev shell
steps.zh: 克隆单体仓库，进入钉好版本的 Nix 开发环境

steps.en: Start the local stack, passing your Google OAuth keys so Gmail can link
steps.zh: 启动本地整套服务，并传入 Google OAuth 密钥以便接入 Gmail

steps.en: Builds the Rust services, boots database, search, queue and auth containers, prints the URL
steps.zh: 编译 Rust 服务，拉起数据库、搜索、队列和登录服务，打印地址

steps.en: Sign in with any email; the one-time code lands in the local Mailpit inbox
steps.zh: 用任意邮箱登录，一次性验证码投到本地 Mailpit 收件箱

steps.en: In a channel, @mention an email, doc, task or company record
steps.zh: 在频道消息里 @ 一封邮件、一篇文档、一个任务或一个客户记录

steps.en: Stores a two-way link and shares the mentioned item with every channel member
steps.zh: 记下双向链接，并把被 @ 的东西共享给频道全体成员

value.en: Email, chat, docs, tasks and CRM point at each other in one database — no more pasting links between five tools or chasing access requests
value.zh: 邮件、聊天、文档、任务、客户记录在同一个库里互相指向，不再在五个工具之间贴链接、等别人开权限

sources: https://github.com/macro-inc/macro/blob/main/docs/RUNNING_LOCALLY.md (nix develop, just run_local --no-doppler --env-file ./local.env, infra list, Mailpit at http://localhost:8025, GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID keys)
